text: 中国人民银行主管的《金融时报》发文称，一部被网友调侃“画质感人”的国产动画电影，成了暑期档最魔幻的院线“奇迹”。8月16日下午，同花顺热股榜前五席中，金牛化工、公牛集团、铜牛信息3只名称带“牛”字的个股集体上榜，金牛化工以39.6万的热度登顶。8月17日，“牛字辈”个股盘中一度冲高，但最终涨幅收窄，这本质上是“谐音梗”引发的短期情绪脉冲。
text_en: The Financial News, under the People's Bank of China, reported that a domestic animated film mocked by netizens for its 'grainy visuals' became the most surreal box-office 'miracle' of the summer season. On the afternoon of August 16, among the top five on Hithink's hot-stock list, three stocks with the character 'Niu' (bull/ox) in their names—Jinniu Chemical, Bull Group, and Tongniu Information—appeared together, with Jinniu Chemical topping the list at 396,000 in popularity. On August 17, 'Niu'-named stocks briefly spiked intraday but ultimately pared gains, reflecting a short-term sentiment pulse driven by a homophone meme.
